decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (7 points in total)
fact: Car 22 collided with Car 18 in Turn 8.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. On lap 6, Car 22 (TSU) approached Turn 8 carrying much more speed than the cars ahead, closed up on the inside behind Car 18 (STR), and made contact with the rear of that car, causing a collision and forcing Car 18 into a spin. The Stewards determine that Car 22 was wholly responsible for the incident, and the standard penalty for causing a collision was applied.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 22 Causing A Collision With Car 18 In Turn 8
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
